meta_description: A photo gallery of costumes from previous years — inspiration for putting together your own kit for The Lord of the Rings 2026.
intro: A gallery of costumes from previous years. How players of each army look on the battlefield and around the camp. Click an image to enlarge.
preparing_text: We're putting together the gallery for this army. If you have your own photos from past years and want to share them, write to info@panprstenu.cz.

armies.title: Gondor
armies.subtitle: Guardians of the White Tree, the pride of Númenor and the last shield of the West.

armies.title: Rohan
armies.subtitle: Lords of horses and riders of the Mark, the wind of the green plains in their saddles.

armies.title: Elves
armies.subtitle: The Firstborn — memory of ages past and the quiet light of a fading world.

armies.title: Dwarves
armies.subtitle: Folk of stone, metal and deep halls — hard as rock and true as steel.

armies.title: Orcs
armies.subtitle: The hungry maw of the Shadow — the roar of battle, filth, fury and fear.

armies.title: Uruk-hai
armies.subtitle: Uruk-hai of the White Hand — born of treachery, forged for war.

armies.title: Harad
armies.subtitle: The Haradrim of the hot South — scarlet, gold, the dust of long roads and the shadow of mûmakil.

armies.title: Umbar
armies.subtitle: Corsairs of Umbar — black sails, the salt of southern seas and blood on the blade.

armies.title: Hill-men of the Highlands
armies.subtitle: Hill-men of the Highlands — the wind on the mountain ridges, coin in the purse and honour written into the spoken word.
